description: This is a code-behind file for the 'EditMCQ' webpage in an online examination system. It handles UI interactions such as course selection based on semester, navigation between pages, and session management.

classes.name: EditMCQ
classes.description: A partial class representing the code-behind for the 'EditMCQ' WebForm page, managing course selection, page navigation, and session state.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initialization when the page loads; currently empty.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers page to 'AdminPanel.aspx' when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers page to 'AdminQueue.aspx' to view profile or queue.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the 'SelectCourseDropDownList' based on the selected semester.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and transfers to 'LoginPage.aspx'.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the available courses in 'SelectCourseDropDownList' based on the selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Currently empty; placeholder for handling course selection change.
